description: Na₃Sc₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.95 Å. Sc³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.09 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. P⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-29°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.53 Å. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Sc³⁺, and one P⁵⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Sc³⁺, and one P⁵⁺ atom.
